build_dataset_criteo: build a tensorflow dataset builder for the Criteo uplift modeling dataset with 25M rows
create_dataset_info: create dataset metadata with 12 float features, treatment indicator, and binary labels for visit and conversion
download_criteo_dataset: download and extract the Criteo uplift CSV dataset from the official Criteo research URL
generate_criteo_examples: generate examples from the Criteo CSV file using DictReader with 14 feature fields per row
split_criteo_dataset: split the Criteo dataset into train split with features and supervised keys for uplift prediction
